heading: System integrations. Workflow automation. Expert bookkeeping.
body: McCullough Clark is an operations firm for businesses built on expertise, with two specialist practices. One designs and builds integrations, automations, reporting, and practical AI tools. The other provides monthly bookkeeping led by an IRS Enrolled Agent. Engage either practice independently—or benefit from both when a need crosses disciplines.
reassurance: No bookkeeping engagement is required for systems work. No automation project is required for bookkeeping.
